download_s2ef_data: run the download_data script to download and preprocess S2EF training data for a specified split like 200k or all
download_is2re_data: run the download_data script to download and extract IS2RE train val test LMDB data
run_get_data: run the get_data function to download extract and preprocess data for a given task and split
run_uncompress_data: run the uncompress_data function to decompress a compressed S2EF data directory using the uncompress module
run_preprocess_data: run the preprocess_data function to preprocess uncompressed S2EF data and write output to a specified path
